text:
@@qkanerd to how upset this makes me, I could be ranting here til next week. A lot of respect to the persons that keep coming back to stream these songs, and to the fanbases on the different social media platforms that are trying to get persons to engage. The whole February we were just trying to get TWO MILLION VIEWS. Just 2! And now its already march 7 and we’re still 100k+ off🤦🏽‍♀️

text: Here is my personal analysis of the song and it's meaning: To me, the song is about being in a relationship with someone who is toxic and that you know is toxic. The mentioning of the word spiderweb shows this. Insects get caught in spiderwebs which could also represent being caught or stuck in a toxic relationship. A lot of the lyrics talk about being stuck, along with poison and other things such as that which furthers my point of being stuck in a relationship. At the end, Felix and Seungmin find the exit to wherever they are which means that they are able to leave but they close the door and stay. To me, this represents willingly staying in the relationship even if you are able to leave because you love the person or because you enjoy their presence. All in all, this song is not only catchy and pleasing to listen to, it's also very meaningful to me and something that makes me think about past experiences. Very good song, 10/10 recommend and thank you for reading! <3

text:
OK WAIT… tell me if im going crazy, but...at 0.40 s, when seungmin is in the hallway, it kind of reminds me of the hallway in the red lights mv, plus the red string, that is in both mvs, hyunjin is wrapped in it in red lights but seungmin is just touching it in venom.  Seconds later, we see lee know, in front of a mirror that is strangely similar to the one that hyunjin and bangchan are facing at the end of the red lights mv. And then, lee know looks at himself in the mirror then walk away from it, while his "image" is still in the mirror, and doing some kind of sign with his hand that i can't see clearly because of the mirror crack, but it might look like some sort of gun hand sign, or otherwise like the point choreography in MANIAC.
What is really questioning me is mainly the resemblance between the two hallways and the red strings. I also want to talk about the kind of fest, that we can see in both mvs, with hyunjin and bangchan in the red lights one, and with all the group in this one (1.50). What i can also see is that the idea of being trapped somhow, with handcuffs, chains...is very present.
Tell me what you think about it, this is not a theory but just some observations.

author: @h-playwithmyhart.4806
text: Bang Chan. As I’ve frequently noted, I have been a K-Pop fan for almost a decade but I have never seen somebody like you in the musical field before. What you have been and are capable of, is absolutely untouchable and I’ve learned that there is nothing that can take the sincerity and passion out of your character. I will say, despite being a long-time fan of K-Pop, I didn’t become a Stay until the just a few years ago. I don’t know how I went so long without knowing or supporting Stray Kids sooner, but I am completely and utterly thrilled to be a Stay now. To this day I wouldn’t know about Stray Kids if it weren’t for the Stay. I heard so much conversation among the fans of Stray Kids about how fearless of a leader you were, and I became curious. Over the course of those few years, I have spent my free time, which I lately have a lot of, getting to know you and your members. It started with liking a few songs, but then Stay, who talk with so much praise about you and your members, convinced me to see what was lying beneath the meaning of your music. I began to watch Stray Kids content whenever and of whatever I could, and I gradually fell more in love with your performance and personality overall. I have come to know how passionate and dedicated you are and have always been to music and performing. Even before Stray Kids was officially formed and debuted, you had music in your heart and I can see that clearly every time that you go on stage with your members. Not only do you have a naturally beautiful voice evident of vocal capability and strength, but your dancing skills are rigid and flawless beyond words. Your presence on stage is nothing less than inspirational and you ground and center your members in a way that I’ve never seen before. You always bring everyone together and emit unity on and off the stage. Outside of your musical performances, however, I have gotten the pleasure of getting to know you and your personality. I don’t even really know where to start by how touched I am at the positive impact you have already made on this world despite still having so much more left to say. Before I became a Stay, I didn’t know much about what Stray Kids had gone through to get where they are now; and I didn’t know just how much you went through either. However, the loving Stay introduced me to how hard you worked individually to keep your members’ heads above water through the rigorous days of training, performing, and other events that swarmed you. I was, and still am absolutely mesmerized at what you have accomplished to make this group possible, and successful beyond its comprehension. Thanks to the Stay, I know that before Stray Kids even debuted, you formed an unbreakable and unique bond with each of the members as well as one together as a whole. You lift your members up with the emotional and motivational weight of all the words that you’ve ever said to them. To know that there would be no Stray Kids without you makes me love you in a manner that is simply indescribable. I know that I, your members, and the Stay have so much respect and admiration for you because of everything that you’ve done and overcome in just the beginning of your musical journey. I have gotten the honor of seeing at least some of the group’s history and how it came to be, and seeing how you were a huge part of that makes me appreciate having you in my life more than I did before. You have single-handedly helped carry this group to victory and done so much to ensure that you stay together. You have always kept your promise that you, in words that I once heard you say, “Don’t leave anybody behind.” On top of leading your group to all of its success and glory, your are also humble and kind and always put them first. You sacrifice so much for your music, your members, and Stay and we recognize how hard you work day in and day out. You are so funny, clever, and know not to take life too seriously. At the same time you are professional, intelligent, respectful, and wise beyond your years. You are every bit qualified to be the leader that you are and I hope you never doubt your capability of doing that because Stay have seen you build something beautiful with your own two hands from the ground up. You never gave up even when the world encouraged you to and from that I find so much inspiration that I don’t even know how how to thank you. All I do know is that your family and parents are the most proud of you and love you more than any of us do. I can’t even imagine how strong they think you are for what you’ve created. I don’t want to put any more pressure or a burden on you, but so much would crash and burn without you and I hope that our love and support is enough to lift you up through your darkest times. You deserve so many blessings and praise. I just hope that you know your efforts are being recognized every second and that Stay, your members, and your family love you beyond words. I can’t thank you enough for everything that you’ve already done. You make Stay and your members feel so valued and desired and I know that only you can do that. I can’t wait to see what you do next because I know that I couldn’t leave you or stop supporting you if I tried. On behalf of your friends, Stay, members, and most importantly family, I pray that this birthday is filled with all of those blessings that you deserve and that it’s everything that you desire. I pray that you and your loved ones remain in good good health and good faith, because the world is relying on it in order to fully heal and love each other. Happy birthday Bang Chan, and from the bottom of my heart, we absolutely adore you!! You make Stray Kids all around the world stay!!

author: @h-playwithmyhart.4806
text: Felix. You have to be one of the biggest blessings on this Earth. I know that I crossed paths with Stray Kids for a reason, and I know you were one of those reasons. Before I even knew anything about Stray Kids, I knew about you. Three years ago, when I got my introduction to K-Pop and was beginning to like quite a few groups, I didn’t know much about Stray Kids, but I did know about you. I couldn’t go anywhere without hearing anybody talk about you, and that was what lead me into wanting to find out more about you, and your position in Stray Kids. I came into the fandom blindly, without knowing any of the names of the members, and relied on the Stay to tell me everything I needed to know about you. It was because of the intense loving fanbase that you have that I learned, in only a matter of days, what a rare talent you are. The depth of your voice combined with your passionate vocals is one of the most beautiful sounds I have ever heard. Your rapping and singing abilities are entirely specific to you and are so captivatingly intriguing, that I knew I loved you from the moment I first got introduced to you. You are so flexible with your voice and on the stage; and once I first got notice of how outstanding you are, I couldn’t stop discovering what made you so enticing and lovable. You are so recognized and appreciated for your natural talent that word reached me about how special you are before I even got a chance to know who Stray Kids really were. Since then, I have been a Stay, and I can say that you are an individual that led me to become one. I have never seen someone with such a bright presence and spirit completely dominant on stage and create an environment so mysterious and energetic for so many people. You bring to music what nobody else can, and I am so happy you share that with all of your Stay when you could be doing something else. I see how happy that you make your members, and since I am a relatively new fan, I still have yet to learn everything that Stray Kids has been through in the years that you’ve been active. However, I have already seen how much you have healed your members when they needed you the most and provided for Stay a support system that they can actually believe in. You are such a delight to be around and I get so happy just seeing your face these days, especially with all of the craziness that’s in the world. You have a strong-willed heart, and you are extremely kind, forgiving, and non-judgmental. I have loved becoming so acquainted with you and appreciating all of your hard work because you deserve it! You do so much for everyone, and I hope you know that you are so loved and Stay are so grateful to you for even the little things that you do every single day! Never give up and I hope you continue to be the person that uplifts Stay and your members! I know that no matter what happens, Stay will always support you and I can’t tell you how much you really mean to all of us. Thank you so much for being such a kind and loving human being, and for accepting me and so many people into your family as Stay! I pray that you and your loved ones stay safe, and find happiness and worth in the future! On behalf of your friends, members, Stay, and most importantly, your family, I want to wish you the most entertaining and enjoyable birthday ever!! Felix, have fun, PLEASE, PLEASE, PLEASE, stay safe, Happy, Birthday, and WE LOVE YOU!!!!

author: @h-playwithmyhart.4806
text: Jisung. Deciding to support Stray Kids has been one of the best decisions of my entire life, and you are one of the people who are the reason why I do so. I only just started supporting K-Pop groups three years ago, and I discovered so many groups because I had the time on my hands. However, since I graduated high school I have found I have been a lot busier and unfortunately haven’t been able to dedicate my time to supporting these groups that I like. I didn’t think that there was going to be any time left for me to support another group, but then you came along. My first experience from Stray Kids was the song ‘Side Effects,’ and it fortunately was a song where I got to hear the vocal and rap blend of your versatile voice. Next, it was ‘Boxer,’ which despite it being an upbeat song, almost moved to to tears because of how beautiful your voice sounded.  After that, I watched you on ‘The Masked Singer,’ and I couldn’t stop from there. I quickly learned that there is nothing that you can’t do. You are a stunning vocalist, flexible rapper, and outstanding dancer. Overall, this allows for you to be one of the most exceptional performers that I, and other Stay, have ever come to know. I knew, right from the moment that I heard your voice, that I had to have more. I kept going, and since then, I have come to learn so much about you and the legacy that you have already left on music. Stay is one of the most unique fandoms that I have been so fortunate to join, and I now know that you are one of the reasons why. I had always thought about Stray Kids as being such an active group and constantly releasing music and content to show how much Stay meant to them, only to find out that you have been such a huge part of that all along. I haven’t even been a Stay for very long yet, but I already have seen the indescribable impact that you left on Stay. It is unlike anything that I have ever seen. I can see how happy, inspired, and desperate that Stay are to reciprocate every ounce of love that you give to them. When I became aware of this, I knew I had to be a part of it. You are so generous, honest, loyal, and possibly most importantly, I have seen you completely change the type of day someone is having just by setting the mood. Whether it be your members, or Stay, you always make sure that everyone is having the best day possible, even it means you have to sacrifice your mood for somebody else. Because you are just naturally funny and inclined to make everybody around you happy, you have an outlook on life that causes everybody you ever meet to be better and happier because of it all. As I’ve said, I haven’t been a Stay for long at all, but on behalf of the other fans, I already can’t even thank you enough for everything that you do every day. You have such a refreshing personality that we all need, especially at this time in the world. I hope that you never lose the innate kindness in your heart and actions; and I am so blessed to be able to thank you for all of it today. On behalf of Stay, who encouraged me to join them and showed me that there are no limits to your love, your members, who adore you quite possibly in a way that no other person can, and your friends and family, who we know are so proud of you, I want to wish you the happiest birthday ever Jisung! I pray that you and your l loved ones stay safe and find happiness and worth in the future. I am so proud of everything that you have accomplished and am so glad I get to see you grow each day now!! PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE stay safe, and I hope you know how much we all absolutely love you so much! Be happy!!!

author: @h-playwithmyhart.4806
text: Seungmin, I would like to wish you an early happy birthday, as the time is drawing close. My introduction to Stray Kids was unique in that the reason I decided to support it was because of the fans. I have been a K-Pop fan for almost a decade, and I have come to support many groups. However, becoming a Stay was a new experience for me because it was the first time that I joined a group because the love from the fans was so strong, I knew I needed to be a part of it. I learned about each Stray Kids member one at a time, and what I learned and admired very quickly about you was your individuality. Every member stands out for their own reasons, but your charm is retaining your individuality and independence while still being a part of something bigger. I became an official Stay two years ago, and since then I have gotten to see how well you blend in with your members. You are such a valued member of Stray Kids, that we can’t see them existing without you. You’ve also created a journey of personal growth and development both musically and personally and I have felt so connected to you since I’ve become a Stay. Your personality is so enticing in that sometimes you can be quiet and shy, but other times you are very vocal and humorous with your members. It’s very powerful that you can be so sweet and naturally kind-hearted without saying any words sometimes, while other times, being open and direct about how you feel. I can see how much your loving personality has impacted your members, because I’ve never seen them happier than when you spend time with them. You are always making your members laugh and motivating them just by putting one smile on their face. I feel so inspired watching you build such a trustworthy relationship with them and want to be at least half as generous as you. I know that your members are so thankful for you everyday and couldn’t be anywhere near as successful without you. I have never heard a fanbase talk so highly and frequently of a member in the way that they honor you. I always hear Stay talking about how gentle and sweet you are; and how much positivity and love you bring to the world wherever you go. Stay talk about your rare, emotion-based, and versatile voice that captivates everyone into your performance. They talk about the flawless and effortless dancing that you work so hard to share with us and spoil us with on every stage. They talk about your overall professional and inspirational performance on stage that leaves every Stay wanting to spend more time with you. I’ve heard so much about how beloved you are Seungmin, and once I became a Stay, I am seeing for myself how much you are adored all over the world. Not only by Stay, but the loving influence that you have on your members makes them and everyone that you meet a kinder and more loving person. Stay praise and speak so highly of you, that I can’t say I’ve experienced a family this loving toward an idol. I just want you know how much love there is everywhere all around the world for you. You are the reason that so many people lift their heads up and keep going another day, including me. There is so much negativity going on in the world right now, and to have you as a role model and see it not preventing you from sharing more love is making the world even stronger and closer to restoring to its greatness. I really feel like we don’t deserve you sometimes because your genuine strong heart is hard to come across these days. I hope that we can repay you even a little bit of the love you’ve shown us in just a few years since your debut. I know you have worked so hard to be where you are and I don’t even want to pretend to know how much you’ve probably gone through. I just want to take this day, and every day afterwards to recognize and let you become aware of how much I, Stay, and your members really love you. I know that your parents and the rest of your family are prouder of you than any other person and they respond to every action you take with great respect, understanding, and love. Your members and family are so lucky to have you and I know that are thankful and appreciative of you every day. Thank you so much for sacrificing more than we know just to make us happy even a little bit. On behalf of your friends, members, Stay, and loving family, I hope that the love that you have given to this world is given back to you on this special day and every day in your future. Please surround yourself by the people that love you most, and let the love that we have for you give you the most fulfillment! I wish you nothing but happiness for you and your loved ones, and I pray that you all stay safe!! Happy birthday Seungmin!! We adore you so much and we are so grateful to have such a bright light in our lives!!!

No matter what the circumstance is for your song, you retain this originality and this sound that nobody else has. The connection between the raps you create and your execution of them is simply seamless.  Your lyrical style is mesmerizing, and watching these musical ideas pop into your head like second nature is truly astonishing. You can also sing beautifully as well, and the rough texture of your voice gives you this edge that lights up all of your lines. It is rare to see somebody be able to master both singing and rapping, and the unique sound of your voice allows for you to become limitless through both. You are also an incredibly skilled dancer. Your moves are so natural, and watching you feels surreal because you become so immersed in your movement. You absorb all of these choreographies, and then interpret them in such a realistic and emotional way. You have so much power and when you dance, yet you have the right amount of control to give off just the perfect amount of expression. You give care to each little gesture, and treat each move with such delicacy. It is a journey from start to finish when you dance, and you take all of us with you without missing a single detail along the way. Overall, you are one among other artists that sincerely represent our generation and capture its essence. Your innovation and relationship with music are so complex and clear at the same time. You are young, but as you become older and more experienced, there is no telling what you’re already curious and inventive mind will supply to the world. Your impact on music and your Stay will be timeless. At the same time that I love your musicality, I love your personality as well. I first noticed that you are so laid-back and have this calming demeanor. You are also unexpectedly hilarious. You make jokes in moments where nobody anticipates and you can change the entire mood of a situation in mere seconds. You are so humble, and place those around you before you no matter what the circumstances. Though I have never met you in person, you have to be one of the best people to be around and I know that your members know this better than anybody else. You really hold your team down, and together, and always find a way to make sure everybody feels included. It has only been a short time since I’ve known you, but I saw almost instantly how your members individually love and cherish you in their own special way. You bring the excitement and thrill of life to them wherever and whenever they need it. You have the biggest heart. You have stood your members up time and time again and pointed them in the right direction if ever they forget what they are chasing after. You are somebody they can lean on through all instances in their life; and have become their brother. We all know that you provide your members with a love that they could not get from anybody else. Though they are all different, you find a way to embrace this and form a sacred relationship with each of them. I know that they will continue to grow and develop, but only with you by their side to guide them through it all. They will continue to be the best versions of themselves and there is nothing that can hold them back because you believe in them with all of your heart and soul. Your love will always trail them and aid them for the rest of their lives. Thank you for raising them, and changing their lives forever so that they can lead the fullest life possible. I want to personally thank your family and parents for raising you and helping you become the aspiring young man you are today. I know how much your family means to you, and you have firsthand showed us what they mean to you and how you spend your time with them. It is clear to see that you already keep this in mind with you at all times, but I just want to say that I hope you can always rely on them in your life when you find you need somebody. When you find yourself having troubles down the line, I hope you can remember the feeling of being with them to restore you to your former state of peace and optimism. Your family loves you more than anybody else on this planet, and I hope you know that when you feel there is nobody who can understand, they will always be there to help you out of any tough situation. They are the most proud of you, will always be the most proud of you, and you honor them with every step you take towards your dream. As Stay, we keep them in our hearts as you do and hope to become as dedicated and authentic through all that we do as they are. Changbin, it is often said that Stay are the luckiest fandom in the world, and I can wholeheartedly agree with that as you are responsible for the truth behind this. You are extremely sensitive and considerate of all of our feelings, and that is perhaps one of the aspects of you that I love the most. You seem to always listen to what we have to say and are even eager to respond to it. When discussing Stay with your members or others, you always have the most original ideas and show us how much you love us through your own eyes. When we chose to become a Stay, you chose us. Your world opened up to us and you invited us to become every bit of a part of you as your members and family.  Similarly to your members, there are Stay from all over the world who come from different backgrounds, and it is only because of you that we are able to come together in unity. I know it’s not always easy to let us in and to see us while you’re in a tough situation, but the fact that you put your fears aside and show up for us every time is the greatest testament of your love for us. You are the first person we turn to when we are down and need cheering up. It is truly the greatest honor getting to be the ones that you work so hard for and trust it all to. You have faith in us when we don’t, and it gives us enough confidence to tackle whatever is thrown at us. Thank you for loving us unconditionally, and being there when nobody else has. Thank you for changing our lives, and being at the heart of the greatest days of our lives. I know that you’ve been through a lot, and you’ve only been active with Stray kids for a few mere years. I’ve seen firsthand how it took all you had and then some to even debut, and there have been too many struggles since then that you’ve faced. The best that I can do, knowing that you’ve been in these difficult situations more than anybody should be in, is try to imagine how it feels to be in your shoes. I know that it’s been a lot. All that I can say, on behalf of all of your loved ones, that we are so proud of you for making it past all of these moments. You have a heart a gold and always keep your head up even when it feels impossible, and I know that this is the reason why you’ve been able to persevere through all that you’ve been through. Thank you for teaching us that we can do the same, and for having enough ability to force a fulfilled live for your Stay and members a well. We know that you can take charge and make it out of whatever happens in the future. I hope that this birthday makes all of your dreams come true and that you accmplish all that you desire on this special day. I often wonder of when you get to take a break and truly look back on the impact that you’ve had on the world, so I hope that if anything, your special day provides you for the perfect opportunity to do that. I hope you are able to look at the countless hearts that you touch every day around the world in limitless ways, and let that make you feel as loved and honored as you’ve ever felt. I hope that those around you also help you to see how worthy of love and commemoration that you truly are. Please relax today and I hope that you spend every second making precious memories. I hope that this day goes down as one of the greatest you’ve had in a while. You deserve all of the sucess and blessings, and I know that more will only come to you. Thank you for sacrificing so much just to make Stray Kids and several other projects possible. Thank you for suffering through any pain, concern, fear, doubt, isolation, confusion, fatigue, stress, and so much more just to bring us any content at all. I hope that you never feel pressured or obligated to change because you are a rare gem of a human being. The world, and more specifically, your Stay need you just as you are to continue to inspire us and remind us what it is to love others and yourself in daily life. You are beautiful inside and out, and perfect as you are. I hope you remember we always will support you no matter what! I pray that you and your loved ones stay safe, and find happiness and worth in the future! Happy birthday Changbin, and we adore you so much!!!!!!!!

이 녀석들은 정말 재능이 있어! 나는 최근에 그들의 음악을 듣기 시작했고 감명을 받았다는 것을 인정해야 합니다. 미국 힙합씬의 언더그라운드 래퍼이자 프로듀서인 저는 다른 문화권의 래퍼들이 창의력을 발휘하는 모습을 보는 것을 좋아합니다. 또한 Stray Kids에 대한 충성심과 열정에 대한 팬층에 박수를 보내고 싶습니다. 지금은 청중이 매우 적지만 언젠가는 이렇게 열정적인 팬층을 갖는 것이 꿈입니다! 노래 잘하는 녀석들! 제 한국어가 서툴다면 죄송합니다. 번역기를 사용해야 했기 때문에 많은 실수와 오역이 있을 거라 생각하지만 그래도 의미가 있기를 바랍니다. 여하튼, 이것을 좋아했고 다음 내용을 듣게 되어 기쁩니다. 새로운 팬이 생겼습니다! : )

These boys are so talented! I just recently started listening to them and I have to admit I'm impressed. As an underground rapper and producer in the American hip-hop scene, I love seeing how rappers from different cultures use their creativity. I also have to applaud your fanbase for their loyalty and passion to Stray Kids. I have a very small audience at the moment but I dream of someday having a fanbase as passionate as this one! Great song boys! I apologize if my Korean is bad, I had to use a translator so I imagine there are plenty of mistakes and mistranslations but hopefully it still makes sense. Anyways, loved this one, excited to hear what's next. You just gained a new fan! : )

author: @carkeyyy
text:
For new STAYs: 
(UPDATED MARCH 27, 2022)

Stray Kids/스트레이 키즈 is an 8 member South Korean boy group who debuted under JYP Entertainment on March 25th 2018 through a survival show which is also called “Stray Kids”. Their group name says it all, it means they aren’t restricted at all; they can do any genre or concept that goes well with the theme they use. It’s been over two years since their official debut, and the first song they have written was “Hellevator” during their pre-debut in October of 2017. They have three subunits within the group, 3RACHA, which is made up by the main rappers and producers of the group. They were also the first three members of Stray Kids and they all currently write and produce all of their songs. DANCE RACHA, which consists of the main dancers of the group and they contribute to making their choreography. And last but not least VOCAL RACHA. VOCAL RACHA consists of two of the main vocalists, and they also happen to be two of the youngest members. Stray Kids is known for their Hip-Hop, Rock, Rap, and EDM style music with unique structures. The leader, Bang Chan, was the one who chose all of the members to be on the survival show. 

3RACHA is a Hip-Hop/Rap subunit that consists of Bang Chan (CB97), Changbin (SpearB), and HAN (J.One) who debuted in early 2017 under JYP Entertainment before becoming a part of Stray Kids. The song “Hellevator” was written, produced, and choreographed by themselves as part of a mission on a survival show, also called “Stray Kids” which was also during their pre-debut in October of 2017. The track itself means that since they’re already in hell, struggling and in pain, they keep going and get on the elevator that will lead them to all their hopes and dreams just so they can get a better future. So technically, the elevator is the way to Heaven. 

All the members can sing, rap, and vice versa. They have a lot of Hip-Hop, Rock, and EDM elements in many of their tracks. One of the members, HAN is one of the youngest producers in the entire K-Pop industry who’s worked alongside Bang Chan and Changbin on all Stray Kids songs/albums. They were often referred to as the next BTS, but not in the sense that they are the same as BTS, in the sense that they all wrote and produce their own lyrics that discuss dark topics that aren’t talked about/taboo in South Korea. Those are other people’s words, not really mine. Stray Kids’s songs often mention mental health, and only a select few of K-Pop artists do that nowadays. They have gone through many struggles that they have experienced throughout the course of their lives, and can be relatable to many people.

author: @Ray-su2oc
text:
Can I just say, this album is everything. I’ve been a stay since the summer before the release of I Am Who, so I’m a veteran stay. But in early 2020, I sort of stopped following skz as much. I don’t even know why, and I feel bad about it, but I think it’s because I was struggling with things a lot with the start of the pandemic. Anyways, this past month, I’ve gotten back into them. I listened to some of their songs over my break from them, like Back Door, God’s Menu, etc, but just recently is when I started listening to everything and watching their variety show episodes and such. I didn’t realize how much I missed them. They helped me through a lot when I followed them, and they’re already helping me again since I started following them again.

Okay, enough of the emotional stuff, now on to my dilemmas. The boys have been bias wrecking me a lot. Jisung is my bias, and has been since pretty much day one. Hyunjin bias wrecked me once, so he and Jisung were both my biases, but other than that, I’ve been a Jisung stan. But man, can I just say that this comeback is making my brain go crazy. Minho’s dancing in the performances of Maniac and his facial expressions (and thighs👀), Felix’s rapping and stage presence, Hyunjin’s rapping and aura and dancing and red hair and pretty much everything, Chan’s vocals in this album and the fact that he’s the best leader and I love him to death, Seungmin’s evolution and vocals and the fact that he can still be insanely hot and charismatic with his braces, the fact that I.N. Isn’t a baby anymore and is actually 3 years older than me but will always be my baby but also makes me wish i could make a copy of him to be my boyfriend, Changbin’s arms and chest and humor and aegyo. Like, I don’t even know who my bias is anymore. Well, I say that, but there are moments in crack and compilation videos where it’s confirmed that he’s my bias, but there are also moments where I don’t think I can pick one.

I know this is a really long comment, but I’ve never commented on YouTube before, but I just couldn’t not express my love for the boys. They’re my babies, but also like my big brothers who take care of me, even though they don’t know I exist. I love them with everything in me, and that will never change. 

Stay strong, Skz. Us stays are always fighting for you and will always love you no matter what. If you boys need to take a break or vacation, don’t hesitate to do so, and don’t feel obligated to do things you aren’t comfortable with or things that you think we want just to make us happy. You make us happy just by being yourselves and pursuing your dreams. Fighting! We love you.
A loyal stay from the US ❤️

author: @kellykuk
text:
When this music video dropped yesterday, I was actually on the bus. I barely contained my excitement. I may have even stimmed abit! 

I hooked up my special cochlear implant earphones and pressed play! Now I've talked about the fact that due to my cochlear implant, i cannot physically handle this song. That creaking sounds makes my internal electrodes buzz and its EXTREMELY disconcerting. Ah well! Ill endure it for Stray Kids ! 😬👍

I was fascinated at the concept! I love how each Kid was evil towards another Kid. I.N towards Chan, Changbin towards the rest of the kids, Hyunjin towards Han and so on!

I really liked the contrast between the light and the dark in all forms. The rooms and the lights! The bright, shiny chains (what is it with chains and you guys?!) and dark outfits!

Can we talk about the spider for a second? How fantastic was that?! I was in awe of the effects and the effort it went to design and make this spider! Then again, you guys can't be accused of doing anything by half, can you? HAHA! 

The visuals of our Kids themselves was just awe-inspiringly beautiful! The makeup and the outfits, once again were amazing. The black suits each and every one of you in all its glorious forms! 

Congratulations Straykids on yet ANOTHER successful masterpiece! This M/V proves that you are the Kings of the 4th generation. Thank you so much for providing us with this extraordinary M/V! We are so proud of you and we love you so much.

Kindest regards,
Kady xx

author: @kellykuk
text:
@@melstay5164 Thank you so much. That means alot. I'm autistic as well as being deaf and I don't think they realise how much they have done for me. 

With how visual their music videos are means I can enjoy them as well as hearing people can. 

I'm autistic but I mask most of the time to the point where people don't realise that I am autistic until I tell them. I act and look more 'adult' when I mask but that's not me. Straykids are helping to slowly break that mask I've had on for over 30 years. 

I hope one day that i can thank Straykids for this.

Kindest regards,
Kady xx

text: The amount of effort and work they put on this video for us is mind blowing. I'm older than them but i  respect them so much! As artists, I love them. As personalities, I adore them! author: @mycustomnovels6095
text: I was first confused what the song is about from the lyrics but the music video plus subtitles here makes it very clear. The song is trying to express how it feels like to be trapped in a particular profession or pursuit. It's like you're suffering doing it, coping with a lot of challenges and competitors on the way, but what are you going to do escaping it? I can imagine as idols fame must feel like a bit of a spiderweb 🕸️ because now it will be very hard for them to come out of it even if they wanted to. And then they wonder why would they ever want to? (I want it more, I need it more). It's a very beautiful song that describes the pain of enduring something but also realizing that not having it is far more painful

author: @thepoetjade
text: I've seen many theories about this MV being the 8 of them fighting over one body or being in a video game controlled by Felix, but even though I know the correlation isn't perfect, I still like to think the MV is about trust instead. They are all constantly putting themselves in danger of one another because they're trusting the other person to not hurt them. They trust Felix not to let the spider get them, Chan trusts I.N with the arrow, Han trusts Hyunjin pulling the trigger, they trust Changbin to free them all, Seungmin and Felix have the opportunity to leave but they don't, etc. This only quasi-fits into the lyrics, which very much seem to be about intoxicating/dangerous love, but even that can feed into trust and how you still hope that person won't hurt you even though you know they're harmful. So at its core, the video is them showing that they would literally die for each other bc they trust one another so intensely.

author: @Anailujrb
text:
Soooo, I'm trying to guess what this song is about (I didn't read much about it, and idk if one of the boys explained it, but here I go):
I think it's about fame. They are talking how they got caught in the spiderweb (fame), how they are getting poisoned (the bad part of fame, like lack of privacy), but still, they can't get out of it, actually, they don't want to leave, they want more (fame).
You can see it's not something good for them, like when Han has a gun pointed in his face, or how Changbin is trapped with knives around him, fame is something that is killing them, but they can't see themselves without it, they want it. When Felix and Seungmin see the exit at 3:05, Felix look at what is outside, but he doesn't leave, he wants to be trapped in the spiderweb.
If you think about Venom, it's an alien that makes him powerful and strong, but it isn't totally good, it's a parasite that's killing him slowly. The same goes with fame, it makes you feel great, you can get money, recognition, but it's also stressful, you don't have privacy, you have to meet your fans expectations, it's a LOT, but as idols, Stray Kids can't live without it.


Or Chan really like Tom Hardy and wanted to make a song about Venom, since they already made one about Deadpool and no deep meaning to it XD
